notes.title: 1.2.0 - Massive performance boost
notes.content:
Learned some things while working on my next game. Decided I'd apply some of them to this one to make it feel better to play. That means a steady 60fps without those hiccups when transitioning between different regions and sub-regions.

Also, fixed a couple bugs. 
[list]
[*] When righting yourself, you no longer sometimes rotate the long way around. Also the animation is a bit faster
[*] When righting yourself with wheels deployed, they don't get all jank-asaurus-rex and drag you to strange places anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.5 - Level tweaks and no powerup spam on load!
notes.content:
Minor changes here.

[list]
[*]Some art was modified in the tutorial area to make sloped chocolate bars more apparently sloped
[*]Some level tweaks were made to make the tutorial and flesh hell a bit easier for new players
[*]When continuing a saved game, you no longer get spammed with all your powerups; Weight will be toggled on-load where relevant
[*]Credits display the developer's new name
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.4 - Bugfix edition
notes.content:
- Fixed a super annoying, kinda rare bug where stuff doesn't load in properly (eg: The ground)
- Adjusted a loading zone to make things less frustrating

notes.title: 1.1.3 - Death Counter and new Achievement!
notes.content:
Another patch, so soon? 

There's now a death counter! And an achievement for beating the game with no deaths.

Also, the played time no longer counts paused time. Oops!

notes.title: 1.1.2 - Tweaks and bug fixes
notes.content:
Made stuff easier, again! Including a lil' speedrun trick.

Also maybe fixed a bug where you can sometimes get stuck in a wall. 
And fixed a bug where some checkpoints were coming back after collected.

notes.title: 1.1.1 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Made some early-game stuff a bit easier
[*] Made a certain path one-way because an easy-mode checkpoint can cause people to think they're going forward when they're actually going backward after a shortcut
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0 - The Easy Mode Update!
notes.content:
- Tweaked some things to be less frustrating
- Added easy mode, gives more checkpoints but disables win-game achievements

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the speedrun achievement being granted incorrectly

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes
[list]
[*]Retuned difficulty in some areas (Easier)
[*]Added clues for where to go after reaching game's midway 
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed some animations/transitions happening too fast on some computers
[/list]

Cool stuff:
[list]
[*]Minor adjustments to level design to further reduce frustration
[*]Segmented time now saved (For runs starting in 1.0.4+) and displayed at the end if you quit mid-run
[*]Controls (Non-customizable) page now displayed, in case you put the game down for a while and forget them
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch notes
notes.content:
Minor changes:

[list]
[*] Made some jumps slightly less frustrating
[*] Made a certain hidden thing a tiny bit easier to spot
[*] RTA Timer shows in credits at the end of full runs, might adjust this later
[/list]

notes.title: Here Goes Muffin will release October 23, 2023
notes.content:
Just over 3 months from now, Here Goes Muffin goes live!

The demo is live now, and your save will transfer to the full game, so no reason not to try it!

notes.title: Here Goes Muffin officially releasing October 23, 2023
notes.content:
At long last, an official release date has been set. Shortly after October's Next Fest, you'll be able to play the full version of Here Goes Muffin!

If you want to try out the game, the demo is live now, and your save will even transfer to the main game so you don't lose any progress!
